from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import ast, hashlib, json, os, subprocess, zipfile

OUT=Path('.tmp/ta01-recovery/checks');OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
REPORT=Path('docs/reviews/ta01-product/recovery-checks-2026-10-20.json')
REPORT.write_text(json.dumps({'state':'running','source':'本次真实检查，完成后写入实际结果。'},ensure_ascii=False)+'\n',encoding='utf8')
env=dict(os.environ)
env['NODE_PATH']='C:/Users/xurx/.tds/workspaces/01a138ab-2566-7f87-9d06-5b16bebd86c2/scripts/ci-bootstrap/node_modules'
commands=[['node','scripts/check-integration-docs.mjs'],['node','scripts/validate-ci.mjs'],
          ['node','scripts/validate-release-workflows.mjs'],['node','scripts/validate-lite-compose.mjs'],
          ['node','scripts/verify-raw-evidence-archive.mjs'],['git','diff','--check']]
results=[]
for i,args in enumerate(commands):
    result=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,env=env,timeout=120)
    for suffix,data in [('stdout',result.stdout),('stderr',result.stderr)]: (OUT/f'{i}.{suffix}').write_bytes(data)
    results.append({'command':args,'exitCode':result.returncode,'stdoutSha256':hashlib.sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest(),'stderrSha256':hashlib.sha256(result.stderr).hexdigest(),
                    'stdout':result.stdout.decode(errors='replace'),'stderr':result.stderr.decode(errors='replace')})
for p in Path('.tmp/ta01-resumption/api-crash-window-a-6g-once').glob('*.py'):ast.parse(p.read_text(encoding='utf8'))
index=json.loads(Path('docs/reviews/ta01-product/recovery-2026-10-20.json').read_bytes())
archive=Path('docs/reviews/ta01-product/recovery-2026-10-20.zip')
assert hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==index['selectedZipSha256']
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
    assert z.testzip() is None and set(z.namelist())==set(index['members'])
    for name,value in index['members'].items():
        data=z.read(name);assert len(data)==value['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==value['sha256']
window_index=json.loads(Path('docs/reviews/ta01-product/amd64-api-crash-window-a-6g-once.json').read_bytes())
window_archive=Path('docs/reviews/ta01-product/amd64-api-crash-window-a-6g-once.zip')
assert hashlib.sha256(window_archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==window_index['selectedZipSha256']
with zipfile.ZipFile(window_archive) as z:
    assert z.testzip() is None and set(z.namelist())==set(window_index['members'])
    for name,entry in window_index['members'].items():
        data=z.read(name);assert len(data)==entry['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==entry['sha256']
value={'at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'hostNode':subprocess.check_output(['node','--version']).decode().strip(),
       'hostYamlVersion':json.loads(Path('node_modules/yaml/package.json').read_bytes())['version'],
       'hostDependencies':'仅复制旧树已有yaml用于静态检查；不改锁文件或guest运行时。',
       'results':results,'diagnosticAst':'passed','preservationArchiveMembersVerified':len(index['members']),
       'windowArchiveMembersVerified':len(window_index['members']),
       'firstFailures':{'pnpm':'PATH不可用，未称已跑五根检查','releaseAndLiteValidation':'首轮ESM缺yaml而失败；复制旧树现有yaml2.9.0后两项通过，未将失败改写成首次通过'},
       'earlierConsoleTest':{'command':['node','--test','scripts/verify-raw-evidence-archive.test.mjs'],'passed':15,'failed':0,'source':'本次执行工具控制台，非本文件的原始子进程日志'},
       'scope':'本机静态资料校验，不是锁定Node环境的五根检查、产品guest验收或P1闭合。'}
value['checkerSource']=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf8')
(OUT/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf8')
REPORT.write_text(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf8')
print(json.dumps({'checks':len(results),'failures':sum(x['exitCode']!=0 for x in results),'archiveMembers':len(index['members'])}))
assert all(x['exitCode']==0 for x in results)
